message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mruby && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"oss-fuzz/mruby_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":6,"var":"Data,size","code":"if (size < 1) return 0;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are accepted as a Ruby source string when non-empty."},
  {"step":2,"file":"oss-fuzz/mruby_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":9,"var":"code","code":"char *code = malloc(size+1); memcpy(code, Data, size); code[size] = '\\0';","note":"The raw input is copied into a NUL-terminated buffer and passed to the interpreter."},
  {"step":3,"file":"oss-fuzz/mruby_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":11,"var":"mrb_load_string(mrb, code)","code":"mrb_load_string(mrb, code);","note":"mruby parses and executes the attacker-supplied program text."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/error.c","function":"mrb_exc_set","line":132,"var":"mrb->exc","code":"mrb->exc = mrb_obj_ptr(exc); ... if (!mrb->gc.out_of_memory && !mrb_frozen_p(mrb->exc)) { mrb_keep_backtrace(mrb, exc); }","note":"When execution raises, mruby stores the exception and captures a backtrace for it."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/backtrace.c","function":"mrb_keep_backtrace","line":209,"var":"packed_backtrace(mrb)","code":"struct RObject *backtrace = packed_backtrace(mrb);","note":"The backtrace is serialized from call frames into a packed RData object."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/backtrace.c","function":"packed_backtrace","line":190,"var":"len","code":"each_backtrace(mrb, ciidx, count_backtrace_i, &len);","note":"Frame enumeration depends on callinfo state and computes the number of entries to store."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/backtrace.c","function":"each_backtrace","line":33,"var":"loc","code":"struct backtrace_location loc; ... if (!ci->proc || MRB_PROC_CFUNC_P(ci->proc)) { ... } else { ... mrb_debug_get_position(mrb, irep, idx, &loc.lineno, &loc.filename); }","note":"Each frame is walked and debug metadata is resolved; the local backtrace_location is populated from stack state before being copied out."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/backtrace.c","function":"pack_backtrace_i","line":171,"var":"*ptr = *loc","code":"*ptr = *loc;","note":"The per-frame struct is copied into heap storage; any uninitialized field in loc is preserved into the packed backtrace."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/backtrace.c","function":"mrb_unpack_backtrace","line":239,"var":"entry","code":"const struct backtrace_location *entry = &bt[i]; ... btline = mrb_format(mrb, \"%s:%d\", entry->filename, (int)entry->lineno);","note":"The sink formats the stored backtrace entries; if a copied field was never initialized, formatting reads it and MSAN reports use-of-uninitialized-value."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, separators=(',',':')))
print('updated')
